title: HTML Headings: h1 to h6 Explained in 60 Seconds
description:
Use h1 to h6 to organize a page into meaningful sections. See the heading hierarchy with a beginner HTML example.

Which heading would you use for a section inside your page: h1 or h2?

Next lesson: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NwK_T8Qxams
Full beginner course: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEJDqf_3IqMU

H one is the highest heading level; H six is the lowest.
Use heading levels to describe the hierarchy of your content.

Try it: Create a page title and a heading for its first section.


Web Development in 60 Seconds • Lesson 3
Learn more: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Core/Structuring_content
